description: This file defines the ActivationLifetime class, which manages the lifecycle and deactivation blocking for an Orleans grain activation. It implements lifecycle observation, cancellation handling, and deactivation lock management.

classes.name: ActivationLifetime
classes.description: Manages the activation's lifecycle, handles deactivation signals, and provides mechanisms to block deactivation when necessary.

classes.name: ActivationLifetime.BlockDeactivationDisposable
classes.description: A disposable resource that when disposed, releases a deactivation lock on the owning ActivationLifetime.

methods.name: ActivationLifetime
methods.description: Constructor that subscribes the instance as a lifecycle observer to the activation context.

methods.name: OnDeactivating
methods.description: Gets a CancellationToken that is triggered when deactivation begins.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Method invoked at the start of the lifecycle; here it completes immediately.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops the activation, cancels deactivation, and waits for pending deactivation locks to clear or a timeout.

methods.name: OnStopAsync
methods.description: Performs an async wait loop until deactivation locks are released or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: BlockDeactivation
methods.description: Returns an IDisposable that blocks deactivation while in scope.

methods.name: BlockDeactivationDisposable
methods.description: Represents a lock on deactivation; increments lock count on creation and decrements on disposal.
